data: Which data point corresponds to the 'Engine 4' model with an average SNR of 10 dB?

The data point corresponding to the 'Engine 4' model with an average SNR of 10 dB is located at approximately 20% CER on the y-axis. This can be determined by observing the position of the triangle marker (representing Engine 4) on the graph at the 10.0 dB mark on the x-axis.
